title: Installation
description: Top of an instance file. Selects the instance before anything is merged, so it stays outside of packages.*

matches.title: Rules
matches.description: Detect this machine and define the site of a request. One rule has to match. A rule matches if all set fields apply.

items.title: Rule
items.description: Every field that is set has to match. A field with several values, separated by commas, matches when one of them does. The most specific rule of all instances wins: an exact host before a wildcard, a host before IP and folder, a longer path before a shorter one.

serverName.title: Host
serverName.description: The host name the browser asks for (SERVER_NAME, HTTP_HOST). * as a wildcard: *.systopic.net. A rule with a host is an address of its site, the first one the canonical one.

serverIp.title: IP
serverIp.description: The address of the server (SERVER_ADDR): what the browser calls when it calls an IP, the socket IP on the command line.

rootDir.title: Project folder
rootDir.description: The folder the project lies in on this machine. A junction matches its target as well.

path.title: URL path
path.description: The start of the URL path the project answers under, beginning with /. /projects/x/ also matches /projects/x/public/. Skipped on the command line, where there is no URL.

site.title: Site
site.description: Set for installations with several sites: the site a request gets when this rule matches. Empty: the default site.

default.title: Default instance
default.description: Taken when no rule matches. LIVE only.
